dataset: IQ-OTH-NCCD (Iraq Oncology Teaching Hospital / National Center for Cancer Diseases)

fine_tuned_experiment.note: Fine-tuning with random geometric augmentations produced lower generalization on this CT dataset. As documented in Cell 44 of the notebook, lungguard_best.keras (the 94.58% model) was copied to LungGuard_AI_Final.keras for production deployment.

clinical_and_validation_limitations: This system is an AI research and educational prototype, NOT a medical diagnostic device.
Dataset split was performed at the 2D image level, not patient/case level. Potential intra-patient correlation leakage cannot be ruled out without patient IDs.
The dataset (IQ-OTH-NCCD) consists of axial slices from 110 patients; demographic and institutional diversity is constrained.
Predictions are statistical likelihoods based on visual feature patterns and must never be treated as definitive clinical diagnoses.
disclaimer: This is an AI research prototype, not a medical diagnostic device. Its predictions are not a medical diagnosis. Please consult a qualified radiologist or healthcare professional for medical interpretation.
